prompt.text: INFINISHELL_GROK_MULTISTREAM: Follow this exact sequence in this single turn: 1. Before calling any tool, output exactly BEFORE_TOOL as ordinary assistant text. 2. Then use only the write tool to create the new file <private-smoke>/empty-project/multistream-write.txt with exactly this UTF-8 content: "INFINISHELL_GROK_MULTISTREAM_FILE\n". The JSON quotes are not part of the file; the escaped newline is one newline. Request approval for that one write. Do not use shell commands, inspect files, or call any other tool. 3. After the write succeeds, output exactly AFTER_TOOL as ordinary assistant text. If approval is denied, do not retry or call another tool.
